A small maintenance release: a security hardening for limited zero-knowledge
shares, the browser-tab favicon back, and a branding tweak. Drop-in upgrade — same
volumes, same database, existing shares keep working.

## Security

- **Zero-knowledge downloads now require proof of key knowledge before they
  count.** For `cf=2` shares, `GET /api/d/<slug>` used to count — and, at the
  limit, burn — a download with no credential at all, so anyone who merely learned
  the slug (from a proxy/access log) could exhaust a limited share and destroy the
  file without ever holding the key. The uploader's browser now stores a one-way
  *key verifier* (`base64url(SHA-256(content key))`, a new nullable `key_verifier`
  column), and the download requires the same value in the `x-fd-key-verifier`
  header — compared constant-time — before anything is counted or served; a
  missing or wrong verifier is a `401` with zero side effects. The verifier reveals
  nothing about the key (the server still can't decrypt), the client derives the
  key *before* fetching (a wrong password fails without a request), and both
  download paths (button + small-file preview prefetch) send the header. Shares
  uploaded before this change (`key_verifier` NULL) keep downloading exactly as
  before.

## Fixed

- **Browser-tab favicon restored.** The gold-feather favicon went missing in the
  v6.0.0 Go/Vite rebuild — the HTML shell no longer linked one and no icon asset
  was served, so browsers showed a blank tab. The transparent gradient feather is
  back (`public/favicon.svg`), linked from the app shell and served at
  `/favicon.svg` as `image/svg+xml`.

## Changed

- **New banner claim and a WeTransfer framing for the description.** The README
  banner claim is now *"Big files, zero baggage."* — on-theme for file sharing and
  the feather-light brand — and the short description positions featherdrop as your
  own private WeTransfer (no accounts, no size paywalls) across the README, the
  GitHub repo description and the Unraid template / CA-feed card. Added
  `.github/assets/gen-banner.mjs`, which regenerates the banner SVG + PNG (the
  feather and wordmark stay verbatim; only the claim is regenerated, set in Lato).

## Maintenance

- Pinned the Go toolchain to `go1.26.5`, which carries the standard-library fix
  for GO-2026-5856 (an Encrypted Client Hello privacy leak in `crypto/tls`).
